board.name: Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure

licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA) license
licence.renewalDeadline: June 30 every year (renewal opens May 1; licence year July 1 to June 30). CME is counted on a separate two-year cycle that begins July 1 of each even-numbered year (current cycle July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2028).

ce.cycleStart: July 1 of each even-numbered year (cycle began July 1, 2022 and every two years thereafter)
ce.categoryRules: At least 50 of the 100 hours must be Category 1 as defined by ACCME, AAPA, AMA or AOA. PAs authorized to prescribe controlled substances must include 5 hours on prescribing with an emphasis on controlled substances, counted inside the 50 Category 1 hours.
ce.nccpaNote: Current NCCPA certification is a licensure qualification (Rule 1.3) and, at renewal, evidence of current NCCPA certification meets the 100-hour CME requirement (Rule 1.9; the Board page says it 'satisfies the whole requirement'). The 100-hour record is the alternative, so NCCPA is not itself a renewal condition. The Rule 1.9 paragraph for controlled substance prescribers does not repeat the NCCPA alternative.

topicMandates.topic: Prescribing of medications with an emphasis on controlled substances
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs authorized to prescribe controlled substances (Category 1, counted inside the 50 Category 1 hours and the 100 total)

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 5 Category 1 hours every two-year cycle for PAs with controlled substance prescriptive authority. The Board's CE page says the federal one-time 8-hour DEA training satisfies the Board's controlled substance training requirement; whether that substitutes for the PA 5 hours is not stated.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: PA practices under a protocol mutually agreed with the supervising physician; supervisor and practice information must be reported to the Board through MELS before practice. A protocol must be presented to and approved by the Board before practising more than 75 miles from the supervising physician's primary office (hospitals, state health department facilities, FQHCs and volunteer clinics excluded). Primary care pairings meeting the Rule 1.6 conditions are exempt from the mileage limit. No periodic refiling interval is stated.
practice.notes: New graduates and PAs whose Mississippi licence is their initial licence need on-site supervising physician presence for 120 days or 960 hours (may be reduced if the clerkship was with the supervising physician). Quality improvement program (Rule 1.6): supervising physician reviews a random sample of 10% or 20 charts, whichever is less, every month; the PA keeps a chart review log; documented face to face meeting (in person or video) once per quarter. Primary care PAs with a primary care physician in compatible practice using EMR have no mileage restriction. Notify the Board immediately in writing of termination or change in employment (Rule 1.7).

prescribing.stateCsRegistrationNote: Board adopts the DEA registration in lieu of a separate state registration (Rule 1.5 D.2).
prescribing.separateAuthorityNote: Controlled substance prescriptive authority (Schedules II to V) requires a Board-approved educational program and a Board application; DEA registration required.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 5 Category 1 hours on prescribing/controlled substances per two-year cycle (inside the 50 Category 1 and the 100 total).

rn.renewalDeadline: December 31 of even-numbered years (renewal September to December of even years, together with the APRN)
rn.ceNote: Part 2815 (CE) was repealed in February 2020. 20 contact hours in the prior two years apply only when the nurse has been out of practice more than five years.

aprn.title: APRN, Certified Nurse Practitioner (CNP), State Certification issued by the Board of Nursing
aprn.ceNote: No fixed hour total: maintaining and renewing national certification satisfies the general CE requirement, plus 5 contact hours on controlled substances each certification period.
aprn.pharmacologyNote: The 5 hours are controlled substance CE, required of every APRN regardless of controlled substance prescriptive authority; new graduates within 2 years are exempt for the first renewal only. Upload to CE Broker; earning window January 1 of the odd year to December 31 of the even year.

topicMandates.appliesTo: All APRNs, irrespective of controlled substance prescriptive authority (new graduates exempt for first renewal)

prescribing.separateAuthorityNote: Controlled Substance Prescriptive Authority (CSPA) through the Board of Nursing, completed at initial DEA registration and at each DEA renewal; only Mississippi DEA registrations accepted.
prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: No separate prescriber hour count found beyond the 5 controlled substance hours that apply to all APRNs.
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 5 contact hours per two-year certification period (all APRNs).
prescribing.stateCsNote: No separate state controlled substance registration: the Board of Nursing grants CSPA and then the APRN registers with DEA using the APRN licence number (the Board page says there is no state controlled substance number). All APRNs must register with and use the Mississippi Prescription Monitoring Program, even without a DEA registration.

practice.authorityNote: Label follows the AANP taxonomy (not a primary source). Primary fact: every APRN must practise in a collaborative relationship with a Mississippi-licensed physician under a formal collaborative agreement submitted to the Board.
practice.transitionToPracticeHours: 1,000 monitored practice hours (2,000 if the APRN had under 1 year/2,000 hours of RN experience before the APRN program); APRN program clinical hours may count if national certification is obtained within 2 years; 1 year of active APRN practice in another jurisdiction may satisfy it (Rule 1.3 C). Evidence of completion is submitted within 30 days.
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Formal collaborative agreement submitted to the Board before practice; updated agreement submitted at every renewal; revisions submitted with a fee before implementation; practice site changes approved before practice at the site. 90-day grace period (plus possible 90-day extension) if the collaborating physician leaves. A collaborative agreement is uploaded for each practice site; QA/QI components listed by the Board include collaborating physician chart review of 10% or 20 charts and quarterly face to face meetings.

unverified: MS NP practice authority label 'restricted' is the AANP classification; Mississippi primary sources establish only that a formal collaborative agreement with a physician is mandatory for all APRN practice.

MS PA: whether current NCCPA certification alone satisfies the 5 Category 1 prescribing hours for PAs with controlled substance authority is unclear. The Board CME page says NCCPA 'satisfies the whole requirement', but the Rule 1.9 prescriber paragraph and the renewal page require the 5 hours without restating the NCCPA alternative. The app should ask prescribing PAs to log the 5 hours.

MS PA: whether the federal one-time 8-hour DEA training substitutes for the PA 5-hour prescribing CME is not stated; the Board says only that it satisfies 'the Board's controlled substance training requirement'.
MS NP: the 2025 revision of Part 2840 (PDF modified April 2026) is the version used; the earlier 2022 PDF marked monitored practice hours as suspended and is superseded.

corrections: MS PA licence.renewalCycleYears: cite corrected from Rule 1.13 to Rule 1.12 (Renewal Schedule); Rule 1.13 is Disciplinary Proceedings. Value (annual) unchanged.

MS PA: the 5 controlled substance prescribing hours are Category 1 (inside the 50 Category 1 hours, per the Board's PA renewal page), not merely 'inside the 100'. categoryRules and topicMandates updated.

MS PA: added missed practice duties from Rule 1.6/1.7: monthly chart review of 10% or 20 charts (whichever is less) with a log, documented quarterly face to face meeting, primary care mileage exemption, immediate written notice of termination or employment change.
MS PA and NP: federal one-time 8-hour DEA (MATE) training now confirmed from the DEA's own letter (loaded), replacing the earlier 'not checked against a federal primary source'.

MS NP practice.transitionToPracticeHours: out-of-state credit corrected from '3 years of active practice in another jurisdiction' to 1 year (Rule 1.3 C). The 3-year figure in Rule 1.3 is the experience required of a monitoring APRN, not of the new APRN.

MS NP prescribing.stateCsRegistrationRequired: null changed to false. The Board of Nursing APRN page states 'You will not have a state controlled substance number'; CSPA (Board) plus DEA is the full set.

MS NP: added RN/APRN renewal deadline fact (December 31 of even years, MSBN FAQ), reinstatement CE (40 contact hours, 5 on controlled substances), first-renewal exemption fact, PMP registration required even without a DEA, and the QA/QI chart review and quarterly meeting components.

MS both professions: searched for missed mandates (opioid/pain, implicit bias, human trafficking, child abuse, ethics, HIV, end of life, Alzheimer, suicide prevention, infection control, cultural competency, domestic violence). Part 2615 R. 1.9 and Part 2840 R. 1.2 B contain no topic mandate other than the controlled substance hours; none added.
